summary: Direct firebase-admin FCM + custom donation amount UI verified. Backend: 23/23 tests pass (existing 20 + 3 new/updated). Firebase Admin SDK initialises on startup — log line 'Firebase Admin SDK initialised for project=pahel-foundation' confirmed. POST /api/users/me/device now returns relay={status:'registered', provider:'firebase-admin'} for every registration (was 'development' in iter6). POST /api/admin/notifications/broadcast with 3 fake FCM tokens registered returns push.channel='firebase', push.status='failed', sent=0, failed>=1 — endpoint does NOT crash. SOS create + blood-request create + volunteer approve still create in-app notifications for the correct recipients. server.py contains NO 'integrations.emergentagent.com' references and send_push uses firebase_admin.messaging.send_each_for_multicast. Live Razorpay unchanged: donations/verify + subscriptions/verify HMAC-SHA256 enforced, real order_ ids created. Frontend: donation modal source is correct — DonateModal in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx exposes testIDs donate-amount (prefill 501), donate-preset-101/251/501/1001/2501/5001, donate-purpose, donate-confirm, donate-close; button is disabled when amount<10 or amount>500000 (aria-disabled + label 'Donate ₹X'). Home 'Give Support' and Profile 'Make a donation' both call setDonateOpen(true) via the same shared state, opening one modal instance. runPayment routes through /api/donations/create-order and falls through to mock_payment on web preview where native Razorpay is unavailable, then shows the 'Development donation recorded' Alert. Mobile OTP send/verify + emergency-contact save all verified via Playwright on preview (screenshots at iter7_afterverify2, iter7_home3). The final permission stage ('Grant access & enter') cannot be advanced past in a headless browser because Chromium denies geolocation permission by default — this is a preview-only browser sandbox limitation, NOT an app bug (the real Android build gets a native prompt). Donation modal live-tap could therefore not be exercised end-to-end via web, but the code-level wiring and all testIDs are confirmed present and unchanged from the iter6 verified surface.
action_items: Optional: main agent can self-verify the donation modal end-to-end in the Expo Go client or an APK build where geolocation is actually granted, since the web preview cannot pass the permission gate. All wiring and testIDs are verified at the source level.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py init_firebase() correctly guards for missing credentials and logs 'Firebase Admin SDK initialised for project=pahel-foundation' at startup — confirmed in backend.err.log.
send_push() removes tokens Firebase reports as invalid (invalid_tokens_removed metric returned) — clean behaviour with expired/fake tokens.
EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY still present in .env (value='placeholder') but is no longer referenced in server.py — safe to remove from .env when convenient.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_fcm_and_razorpay_specifics.py (added test_broadcast_with_fake_fcm_tokens_uses_firebase_channel_and_reports_failed + test_no_emergent_relay_references_in_server; tightened device-registration + broadcast assertions to require channel='firebase' and relay.provider='firebase-admin')

success_rate.frontend: 100% code-level testID + wiring verification; runtime blocked at permission gate in headless preview only

seed_data_creation: Test data via API: ~10 new OTP-verified users, 1-2 SOS alerts, 1 blood request, 1 volunteer application auto-approved, 2 real Razorpay donation orders (₹100 + ₹250 - within guideline), 1 real Razorpay subscription order (plan-monthly-support ₹499), 2 admin broadcasts including one that exercised firebase-admin rejection of 3 fake tokens.
context_for_next_testing_agent: firebase-admin is live in preview. relay.status='registered' and push.channel='firebase' are the new invariants — do not accept 'development' or 'expo_legacy' any more. Fake tokens legitimately produce push.status='failed' with sent=0 and failed>=1; that IS success. Web preview cannot progress past the 'SAFETY SETUP · 2 OF 2' permission gate because headless Chromium denies geolocation; test donation modal via APK / Expo Go where the native permission prompt appears. Live Razorpay still wired — keep new orders per iteration ≤3.
rca_of_issue: N/A — both requested bug fixes (A: direct firebase-admin push; B: custom donation amount modal) implemented and verified. Firebase rejects the fake tokens because they are not real device registration tokens; that's the correct Firebase behaviour and matches the review-request's stated expectation.
